comment: A large filament erupted with an associated partial-halo coronal mass ejection (CME) yesterday afternoon(UT), 28-SEP. Analysis shows that this CME is likely to interact with the Earth's magnetic field towards the end of the forecast period, on or around the 2-OCT and on impact we could see STORM G1 periods.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
